author: DankShotLOL
body: In a game called "control the hill", I was banned for turning around and attacking another player. I think it's unfair that it's considered "kill aurua" or whatever it's called for me attacking another player by luck. In the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mT5jQj1Bqeo&feature=youtu.be it show's me attacking that player yes. But when I was playing, I was already running toward that person but I turned around to attack the player on the statue. Knowing he was still behind me running from spawn. I quickly turned around and started attacking him. I was also the first one hit giving me another opportunity to turn around and attack. I don't know what hack does this and if it appears to be that I supposedly have this, I assure you I don't. Please take the time to look at the link (video) and this discussion. I'm hoping to be unbanned after this.
